id: 04_Hot Work Safety in hindi Hot Work hazards & precautions in hindi HSE STUDY GUIDE
title: 动火作业的危害与预防措施
source_doc: course/Electrical Safety Series/04_Hot Work Safety in hindi Hot Work hazards & precautions in hindi HSE STUDY GUIDE.md
author_source: project/Electrical Safety Series/04_Hot Work Safety in hindi Hot Work hazards & precautions in hindi HSE STUDY GUIDE/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前，白板旁画着火焰和焊花，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a whiteboard with drawings of a flame and welding sparks, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲动火作业。
overlay: 动火作业的危害与预防

shots.scene: 火焰、警示三角、盾牌三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a flame, a yellow warning triangle and a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 什么是动火，有哪些危害和预防。

shots.scene: 工厂车间里，老李拿着焊接面罩走向一段钢架
shots.prompt_en: In a factory workshop, the facility engineer carries a welding helmet toward a steel frame.
shots.narration: 车间里要焊一段钢架。

shots.scene: 阿杰跟在后面，手里拿着角磨机，头顶冒出问号
shots.prompt_en: The young male student follows him holding an angle grinder, with a question mark bubble above him.
shots.narration: 阿杰做助手，负责打磨。

shots.scene: 欣欣在白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of the whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 开工之前，先把动火弄明白。

shots.scene: 喷灯火焰和丙烷、丁烷气瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a gas torch flame and two small fuel gas cylinders. No people.
shots.narration: 主要用明火的作业，比如丙烷丁烷，

shots.scene: 电焊、打磨两个图标，都冒火花
shots.prompt_en: Two icons each throwing sparks: an arc welding torch and an angle grinder. No people.
shots.narration: 或者会产生明显火源的，如焊接打磨。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着火花图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a sparks icon on the whiteboard.
shots.narration: 这些都叫动火作业。

shots.scene: 空白许可单上盖章打勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank work permit form receiving a stamp and a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 动火作业，必须先办作业许可PTW。

shots.scene: 火花落向纸箱燃起火焰，气瓶旁有爆炸图标
shots.prompt_en: Sparks fall onto a cardboard box that catches fire, and a burst icon appears beside a gas cylinder. No people.
shots.narration: 危害一：火灾和爆炸。

shots.scene: 火花四处飞溅
shots.prompt_en: Sparks flying in all directions across a workshop floor. No people.
shots.narration: 危害二：火花。

shots.scene: 焊机电缆破皮冒出闪电
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a welding machine with a damaged cable sparking, with an electric shock warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 危害三：焊机砂轮机漏电会触电。

shots.scene: 焊点上方升起灰色烟雾，旁边肺部图标
shots.prompt_en: Gray fumes rising from a welding point toward a lung icon with a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 危害四：焊接产生有毒烟气。

shots.scene: 刚焊完发红的工件，伸手去摸的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a freshly welded glowing hot metal piece and a bare hand reaching toward it, with a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 危害五：工件很烫，一碰就烫伤。

shots.scene: 眼睛图标正对强光
shots.prompt_en: An eye icon staring directly at a bright welding light with a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 危害六：红外线，裸眼看焊接伤眼。

shots.scene: 焊条与工件之间耀眼的电弧图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bright electric arc between an electrode and a metal plate with a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 危害七：电弧。

shots.scene: 没有护罩的砂轮碎裂，碎片飞出
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a grinding wheel without a guard cracking apart with fragments flying, red warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 危害八：砂轮没护罩，碎了会伤人。

shots.scene: 耳朵和抖动的手两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: an ear with loud sound waves and two hands with shaking lines. No people.
shots.narration: 还有噪声和振动。

shots.scene: 老李和阿杰把纸箱、油桶搬离作业点
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer and the young male student carry cardboard boxes and a closed oil drum away from the work spot.
shots.narration: 预防：把易燃可燃物移出作业区。

shots.scene: 固定的柜子被防火毯盖住
shots.prompt_en: A fixed cabinet covered with a flame resistant fire blanket. No people.
shots.narration: 移不走的，用防火毯盖上。

shots.scene: 阿杰清扫地面，拖干积水
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sweeps the floor and mops up a puddle near the work spot.
shots.narration: 地面扫干净，也不能有水。

shots.scene: 老李穿戴焊接面罩、皮围裙、长袖皮手套
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer puts on a welding helmet, a leather apron and full length leather gloves.
shots.narration: 穿戴防护：长皮手套、围裙、面罩，

shots.scene: 皮护腿、袖套、过滤口罩图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of leather leg guards, leather sleeves and a filter mask. No people.
shots.narration: 皮护腿、袖套和过滤口罩。

shots.scene: 焊机电源接在带漏电保护器的配电箱上，外壳接地
shots.prompt_en: A welding machine connected to a socket box with a residual current breaker, its case linked to a ground symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 电源配30毫安ELCB，并且接地。

shots.scene: 狭窄空间入口旁有空白气体检测仪图标
shots.prompt_en: A narrow congested area between pipes with a blank gas detector icon at its entrance. No people.
shots.narration: 狭窄拥挤的区域，先做气体检测。

shots.scene: 老李戴焊接面罩，阿杰在旁也戴面罩递工具
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer wears a welding helmet while the young male student beside him also wears a welding helmet and hands him a tool.
shots.narration: 焊工戴面罩，助手也要戴。

shots.scene: 灭火器标志下有灭火器和灭火毯
shots.prompt_en: A fire extinguisher sign above a fire extinguisher and a folded fire blanket next to the work spot. No people.
shots.narration: 备好灭火毯和灭火器，

shots.scene: 小研拿着灭火器站在作业点旁看护
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands watch near the work spot holding a fire extinguisher.
shots.narration: 再安排一名看火人。

shots.scene: 作业点四周围上防火挡板
shots.prompt_en: Flame resistant screens set up around the work spot, sparks stopped inside. No people.
shots.narration: 火花百分之百封闭，不让飞出。

shots.scene: 带挡帘的焊接棚
shots.prompt_en: An empty welding booth with flame resistant curtains in a workshop. No people.
shots.narration: 焊接放在焊接棚里做。

shots.scene: 作业区周围空无可燃物，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A top view of the work spot surrounded by a clear empty zone, with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 再强调：作业区不留可燃易燃物。

shots.scene: 砂轮机护罩完好，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: An angle grinder with its wheel guard properly in place, green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 打磨：砂轮机要有护罩。

shots.scene: 手松开开关，砂轮停转
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand releasing the switch of a grinder, and the wheel stops. No people.
shots.narration: 要有松手即停开关，

shots.scene: 阿杰试按开关，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: The young male student tests the grinder switch before work, and a green check appears.
shots.narration: 并确认它工作正常。

shots.scene: 砂轮片和机器标签比大小
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a grinding disc with a blank rating label and a grinder with a blank rating label, greater-than symbol between them. No people.
shots.narration: 砂轮片转速要高于机器转速。

shots.scene: 耳塞图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a pair of foam ear plugs next to loud sound waves. No people.
shots.narration: 噪声大时，戴耳塞。

shots.scene: 老李护目镜外加焊接面罩
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer wears safety goggles under his welding helmet.
shots.narration: 焊接：护目镜加焊接面罩。

shots.scene: 阿杰护目镜外加面屏打磨
shots.prompt_en: The young male student wears safety goggles under a clear face shield while grinding, with gloves on.
shots.narration: 打磨：护目镜加面屏。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现火焰和许可单图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a flame and a blank permit form.
shots.narration: 动火作业，先办PTW。

shots.scene: 火、火花、电、烟、烫、光六个危害图标
shots.prompt_en: Six hazard icons: a flame, sparks, a lightning bolt, fumes, a hot surface and a bright light. No people.
shots.narration: 火、火花、电、烟、烫、强光都是危害。

shots.scene: 移走、盖毯、清扫三个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: boxes moved away, a cabinet under a fire blanket and a swept floor. No people.
shots.narration: 移走、盖严、扫净，现场先清理。

shots.scene: 面罩、手套、漏电保护器、气体检测仪图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a welding helmet, leather gloves, a residual current breaker and a gas detector. No people.
shots.narration: 全套防护，漏保接地，先测气体。

shots.scene: 挡板、灭火器、看火人、护罩图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a flame resistant screen, a fire extinguisher, a person pictogram watching and a wheel guard. No people.
shots.narration: 封闭火花，备好器材，专人看火。

shots.scene: 欣欣戴着护目镜挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wearing safety goggles waves goodbye at the camera in front of the whiteboard.
shots.narration: 动火守规矩，平安每一天，下次见！
